script.title: Temple of the Evening Bell
script.description: A Japanese Buddhist temple compound with a sweeping irimoya worship hall, an open golden Buddha sanctuary, a three-storey vermilion pagoda with nine-ring sorin, and an open bell pavilion. Deep engawa galleries, curled roof corners, exposed bracket work and stone lanterns frame the ascending approach.
